purpose: Document first-party city-specific registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry/schema review.
assessment: Dehradun District Administration links the official Bhulekh service for viewing land records and directs signed RoR requests to the concerned tehsil land-record computer centre. Uttarakhand’s registration GIS portal describes property-transaction geoservices, but its citizen portal page exposed no parcel layer or public vector schema. No map-backed parcel response was verified at the WUP point.
registryAssessment: The district administration identifies the Board of Revenue in Dehradun and local tehsil land-record computer centres; it confirms city/district land-record activity but not public parcel geometry at the WUP point.

officialPrimarySources.observation: District Administration says land-record details are available on Bhulekh for viewing and signed RoR copies are obtained from the concerned village tehsil computer centre; it identifies the Board of Revenue, Dehradun.

Official Uttarakhand Stamps & Registration Department portal describes geo-enabled services for property transactions and links a citizen portal; no parcel vector layer is documented on the public landing page.
Government of India DILRMP page reports district-level map digitization and georeferencing status for Dehradun; aggregate progress is not point coverage or a public feature service.
Official state Bhulekh URL linked by district administration; page-reader request timed out, with no parcel query submitted.
